items.text: Monday estimated report (no practice): Carolina listed DT Bobby Brown III (hand), CB Akayleb Evans (triceps/knee), G Damien Lewis (knee), OLB Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) and OL Torricelli Simpkins III (ankle) as DNP; WR Jalen Coker (shoulder) limited. PFT counts four starters among the DNPs. Bryce Young (knee) was a full participant.
Carolina placed RT Taylor Moton (fractured fibula) on IR; Monroe Freeling moves to right tackle. LT Ikem Ekwonu is already out for the season.
Carolina CB Jaycee Horn tore a quad and is out indefinitely; Ian Rapoport reports he is headed to IR, possibly for the season.

Monday estimated report: Green Bay listed DT Anthony Campbell (ankle), LB Zaire Franklin (shin), G/T Travis Glover (knee), WR Matthew Golden (shoulder/foot), C Sean Rhyan (ankle) and DT Devonte Wyatt (ankle) as DNP; G Aaron Banks (knee/toe) limited. G Jacob Monk went on IR. Jordan Love and Christian Watson are off the report.
Rapoport: Rhyan likely has a high-ankle sprain (a month or more); Franklin has a hairline leg fracture but isn't expected to go on IR. Edge Micah Parsons (knee) is not expected to play Thursday.

adjust.reason: Carolina may be without four defensive starters (Phillips, Brown, Evans, Lewis) plus RT Moton and CB Jaycee Horn on a short week, which outweighs Green Bay's interior line and linebacker absences. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
